name: dimforge/rapier
description: 2D and 3D physics engines focused on performance written in Rust, supporting cross-platform determinism including web (WASM). Successor to nphysics and the primary physics library in the Rust game development ecosystem.
score_rationale: 5.2k-star Rust-native physics engine with WASM support and cross-platform determinism, key tool for Rust and Bevy game development.
summary: Rust physics engine with deterministic WASM support for Bevy
